title: Sega Rally Championship Plus Netlink Edition
overview:
Get behind the wheel of real World Rally Championship cars from Toyota and Lancia and race off-road against the clock. Power through checkpoints on courses that switch between asphalt, gravel and mud, each surface changing how your car handles, while your co-driver calls out the turns ahead. Climb through the field in the championship and finish in first place.

Tune your own versions of the cars, from handling and tires to suspension, then set lap records in Time Attack against your own ghost or race a friend on a split screen. This Net Link Edition also lets you race opponents online with the Sega Saturn Net Link modem.

- Net Link playable
